title: Position: Beyond Assistance – Reimagining LLMs as Ethical and Adaptive Co-Creators in Mental Health Care
reasoning: The paper introduces the HAAS-e (Human-AI Alignment and Safety Evaluation) framework, which specifically benchmarks LLMs based on 'Bias and Ethical Auditing' as one of its four core evaluation pillars. It proposes metrics and validation methods (like red teaming and ethical auditing) to assess the ethical alignment of models in a clinical context.
